stem: Which feature most specifically points to the relapse pathway in steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome?

options.text: Weaning prednisone is commenced on Day 3 of admission
Parents are taught to test urine
An annual influenza vaccine is recommended

explanation: Weaning prednisone is commenced on Day 3 of admission. This is the most specific feature pointing to the relapse pathway in this scenario.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because starting prednisone weaning on Day 3 of admission is the specific clue that identifies the relapse pathway.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because urine-testing education is general management advice and does not distinguish relapse from first-episode disease.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because pneumococcal vaccination is general preventive care rather than the relapse-specific feature.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because annual influenza vaccination is also general preventive advice, not the key discriminator.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because steroid sensitivity is a general disease characteristic and does not identify the relapse pathway.
